sources.title: Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (Implementation starting with 2021 Primary One Cohort), Updated: Oct 2025
sources.notes: PDF of 50 pages, sha256 e8f77fe10d768e2ad5266dfc39a8821674be7eb1c81bc545ba4b841b12ae70e1. Primary 3 content is in Section 5 on printed pages 35 (Number and Algebra) and 36 (Measurement and Geometry; Statistics); printed 'Page | N' equals the PDF page index for this file. Outcome statements are the syllabus wording for Primary 3, extracted by software (PyMuPDF) and cross-checked against page images of pp. 35-36 by the drafter; a human must still check every statement against the PDF before sign-off. Wording is verbatim (case and punctuation as printed, superscripts written as cm² and m²). Where the syllabus lists bullets under a lead-in (e.g. 'measuring' then 'length in kilometres (km)'), the statement joins lead-in and bullet with unchanged words. A compound bullet is split into separate outcomes only where it contains separately quotable parts (right angles / angles greater than/smaller than a right angle; perimeter bullets). Codes of earlier-draft outcomes are kept where the content clearly corresponds and are never reused for different content; retired codes are listed in curriculum-diff.md. The topic 'notes' field quotes syllabus wording that limits scope. The syllabus lists no separate Primary 3 word-problem or problem-solving content item.
